notes:
PDF has 2 pages total. Page 1 contains the full major-map table (Semesters One through Eight plus Summer); page 2 contains only the Graduation Requirements Summary table, Program Notes prose, and the Codes legend, all excluded from `sections` per instructions. The `program.total_credits_required` value ("120") was sourced from the Minimum Total Hours cell of that page-2 summary table, since it is a program-level fact rather than a semester-table row.

Header block also lists "Retail Management Concentration" beneath the degree line (Major Map: Retailing / Bachelor of Science (B.S.) / Retail Management Concentration / College of Hospitality, Retail, and Sport Management / Retailing Department). There is no schema field for a concentration, so it is only recorded here — `program.major` was set to "Retailing" verbatim from the map title.

The task rationale said this map was chosen for having a Summer section "in the middle of the plan." In this document the single Summer section (6 Credit Hours, RETL 495 Retailing Internship) actually appears last, after Semester Eight, not in the middle of the sequence — flagging this in case it matters downstream.

The Major GPA² column (present in the header) is completely blank for every single row in the entire document — no row has any content there, despite footnote 2 stating some major courses are included in the major GPA. This is either intentional (this particular program's map never flags GPA-inclusion visually) or a rendering limitation; treated as null-equivalent throughout since nothing is printed in any cell of that column.

The ENGL 102 row (Semester Two) has two code values stacked in the Code cell with no visible separator ("CC-CMW" then "CC-INF" on the next line), unlike other multi-value code cells elsewhere in the document that use an explicit slash (e.g. "MR/CC-INT", "PR/CC", "CC/PR"). I transcribed it as "CC-CMW CC-INF" (space-joined) since no slash or comma was printed between them — a parser using "/" as its multi-code delimiter will need special handling for this one row.

The HRSM 201 prerequisite text in Semester Two reads "...enrollment in the BAIS-Services Mgmt. Major," where the hyphen falls exactly at the cell's internal line-wrap point. It's ambiguous whether "BAIS-Services" is an intentional compound program name or the hyphen is a PDF line-wrap artifact; transcribed verbatim as printed.

Footnote digits were kept fused to titles per instructions verbatim (e.g. "Carolina Core Requirement3", "Foreign Language4 or other Carolina Core Req.3", "RETL 295 Retailing Practicum5", "Carolina Core Requirement3 or Elective6", "RETL Elective7", "Elective6", "RETL 495 Retailing Internship8"). The identical placeholder row "Carolina Core Requirement3" recurs verbatim multiple times across different semesters — this is a legitimate repeated generic requirement row, not a duplication error.

All semester credit-hour totals were cross-checked by summing each section's row credits (treating ranges like "3-4" by their range) against the declared header total, and all nine sections balance exactly, giving good confidence in the transcription (e.g. Semester Two: 3+3+3+1+3+(3-4)=16-17 matches "Semester Two (16-17 Credit Hours)").
